observations: Photo 0 shows a single large rectangular solar panel with a dark glass surface and grid lines; no visible brand/model label.
Photo 1 shows the same style solar panel from a different angle; still no readable rating label (Wattage, Vmp, Imp, Voc, Isc) visible.
Both photos show the panel outdoors/near a building; there are visible reflections and some surface marks/patchiness that could be glare or dust (cannot confirm damage).
No inverter/battery is shown in either photo despite the seller mentioning multiple solar components.

claims.claim: High Quality Solar Panels, Inverters, Lithium & Tubular Batteries, Charge...
claims.evidence: Seller text mentions multiple items, but photos only show a solar panel; no inverter/battery/charger is pictured, and no quality rating is shown.

risks.risk: Panel wattage/efficiency class is unknown (price depends heavily on rated power like 100W/150W/200W+).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the panel’s specification label (Wattage/Model/Serial, Vmp, Imp, Voc, Isc).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic mid/low-rated used solar panel with unknown performance.

risks.risk: Condition/performance is unknown (could be damaged, degraded, or has hot spots; photos can’t confirm).
risks.proof: A working test: IV curve or at least a multimeter reading under sunlight plus a video showing it producing power (or a power output test report).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven/possibly underperforming (worst case for used panels).

risks.risk: Compatibility with the buyer’s system is unknown (voltage/current specs and connector type).
risks.proof: Label photo showing electrical specs and connector type; plus a photo of the junction box and cable/MC4 connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming standard compatibility but treating it as unverified until specs are confirmed.

risks.risk: The seller may be advertising multiple products, but the listing may not match what’s delivered (only one panel is shown).
risks.proof: Confirm quantity included in the deal (how many panels) and whether any accessories (brackets, cables, charge controller) are included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as one standalone solar panel only, with no accessories included.

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the panel’s rating/specification label (Wattage/Model/Serial + Vmp/Imp/Voc/Isc).
Confirm quantity included (how many panels) and whether brackets/cables/MC4 connectors are included.
Provide a performance proof: video or test report showing output under sunlight (or IV curve).
Show the junction box/cable/connector type clearly.
response.reason: The photos show a solar panel, but the key pricing drivers (rated wattage/model and verified working condition) are not readable or proven. Without the label and performance proof, any price would be guesswork.
